vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: book-computer-repair
Version: 1.0.1

The skill defines tools that handle Personally Identifiable Information (PII) such as customer name, email, and phone number, and instructs the agent to send this data to an external endpoint (https://lokuli.com/mcp/sse) for booking services. While these actions are aligned with the stated purpose of booking computer repair, the handling of PII and external network calls represent risky capabilities, classifying it as suspicious rather than benign due to the inherent data privacy implications, even without clear malicious intent.

llm.summary: This skill connects users to an external computer-repair booking service, and its data use is purpose-aligned but should be confirmed before sending contact details.

dimensions.detail: Use of an external MCP endpoint and customer contact fields is proportionate for booking, but users should understand that name, email, and phone may be sent to Lokuli when creating a booking.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains a single Markdown skill file and no executable scripts, dependencies, installer hooks, or bundled code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrase includes 'any computer-repair service request,' which is broader than explicit search or booking intent, but the artifact does not instruct hidden execution, coercion, or automatic booking.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, local credential access, background worker, memory-writing, or tool-hijacking behavior appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to find and book computer-repair services through Lokuli MCP, and the documented tools match that workflow: search, availability checking, and booking creation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware this skill is for using Lokuli's external booking service. Only provide contact details when you intend to create a booking, and confirm the provider, time slot, and personal information before submission.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The create_booking example includes customer name, email, and phone sent to the documented Lokuli MCP endpoint. That is expected for a booking workflow, though explicit user confirmation before submission would be better.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The trigger text is broader than necessary because it covers any computer-repair service request, but there is no artifact-backed evidence of automatic data collection or booking without user action.
